headline: Team Values Alignment, from entry to detail
overview: Team Values Alignment helps you build a values-driven team culture. Define your company's core values, craft a team code of conduct, and then invite team members to rate how well the team is living up to each value. The aggregated results reveal alignment gaps and spark meaningful conversations about culture and expectations.
targetAudience: Users interested in career tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Team Values Alignment — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface, with tools to define company values and create a team code.
steps.screenshotAlt: Team Values Alignment landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Define and articulate company values with supporting descriptions
Create a team code that translates values into expected behaviors
Invite team members to rate how well the team embodies each value
Aggregated alignment scores revealing gaps between stated and lived values
tips: Involve the whole team in defining values from the start — co-creation drives buy-in
Review alignment ratings quarterly to track cultural progress over time
